title: MEMBRAIN — AGENTIC MEMORY ENGINE
description: Production-grade agentic memory that lets AI agents revise beliefs, invalidate unsafe decisions and block stale actions. Built on CockroachDB, FastAPI and AWS.

title: FLYBRAIN — NATURE-INSPIRED VISION
description: Open-source research into whether fruit-fly connectome-inspired neural architectures can drive visual navigation, with simulation, interfaces and RL policy training.

title: MARKET STREAM — REAL-TIME DATA PIPELINE
description: Cloud-native market data streaming platform processing thousands of events per second through Kafka, Spark, Airflow and dbt, with Grafana observability on AWS.

title: STORE IQ — RETAIL COMPUTER VISION
description: End-to-end retail analytics pipeline that turns raw CCTV footage into shopper tracking, Re-ID identity, behavioural events and live KPIs over REST and WebSockets.

title: ENTERPRISE RAG — RBAC RETRIEVAL LAYER
description: Production-grade retrieval-augmented generation with role-based access control, so every answer is scoped to what the requesting user is allowed to read.

title: CHATBOT — CONVERSATIONAL AI
description: Conversational AI chatbot in Python with a containerised service, modular utilities and a clean separation between the app layer and its helpers.

title: COINSWAP — CRYPTO EXCHANGE FRONTEND
description: Responsive frontend for a cryptocurrency exchange, covering trading flows, asset listings, fees and account surfaces for beginner and experienced traders.
